name: bitgate
description: Headless Nostr governance SDK for decentralized moderation and access control

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:conformance
scripts.build:types: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.types.json && tsc -p packages/nostr/tsconfig.types.json && tsc -p packages/runtime/tsconfig.types.json && tsc -p packages/bitvid-compat/tsconfig.types.json && tsc -p packages/widget/tsconfig.types.json && tsc -p packages/testing/tsconfig.types.json
scripts.lint: npm run check:references && npm run check:types
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:widget && npm run build:site
